clips.title: The story
paras: The Prodigal Lich Returns marks the conclusion of the effort to recruit Gunther Arcanus into the Forsaken. Having proven your intentions and restored his grimoire, you carry an arcane communion gem back to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.

Gunther Arcanus spent years isolated on an island in Brightwater Lake, having broken free from the Lich King's grip through sheer force of will, completely unaware that Sylvanas Windrunner had liberated Lordaeron. Bitter and suspicious of outsiders, Gunther distrusted the emissaries of the Undercity until an adventurer returned his spellbook and proved their hostility toward the Scourge. Satisfied that his visitor was not an enemy, Gunther entrusted them with a Nether Gem to establish contact with his former colleague.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor. It will let us communicate... And I have much to tell him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you returned Gunther's book? Has he responded?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You convinced him to join us! You have done a great deed for the Forsaken, friend. The Dark Lady will be informed.
